assumptions.topology: Three independently addressable mTLS nodes, one node per host, using a strict topology manifest shared with the independent-host LAN profile.
assumptions.compatibility_window: A named N/N-1 pair; unsupported version pairs must be refused before mutation.
assumptions.workflow: Rolling one-node-at-a-time upgrade, leader movement, identity rotation, rollback, and verified restore through public operator tooling.

required_evidence: clean immutable source commit matching the validator checkout
topology manifest SHA-256 and three distinct a/b/c host identities
from/to version manifest and step transcript
equal committed-state hashes before, after upgrade, and after rollback
unsupported version-pair refusal and verified restore
non_claims: This profile does not prove arbitrary version compatibility.
Same-host lifecycle drills are not independent-host upgrade evidence.
This profile does not replace power-loss or WAN impairment proof.
